full_name: Rebecca L. Walkowitz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Rutgers University
bio: Rebecca L. Walkowitz is an associate professor of English at Rutgers, the State University of New Jersey. Her research focuses on modernism, the contemporary novel, and transnational approaches to literary history.
